name: GDDL Ladder
description: Shows the GDDL top levels and this level's place on the GD Demon Ladder (gdladder.com).

show-level-badge.name: Rank badge on level info
show-level-badge.description: Show this demon's place in the GDDL top on its level info screen. Click the badge to open the level page on gdladder.com.

show-menu-button.name: GDDL Top button in the main menu
show-menu-button.description: Adds a button that opens the GDDL top levels list.

levels-per-page.name: Levels per page
levels-per-page.description: How many levels to show on one page of the top list (5 - 12).
